detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Supports Gamepad (Xbox controller Recommended, PS 4/5 controller with Steam Input)
Supports Keyboard/Mouse

Enter the ring in a physics-based anime boxing game built around fast decision-making, player expression, and satisfying knockouts.

Create your own boxers, develop your fighting styles, and take on opponents of all shapes, sizes, and difficulties. Level up, learn new abilities, unlock stylish attire, and build fighters that play exactly the way you want.

CHOOSE YOUR GAME MODE

Enhanced
Experience GloveUp! as intended. Level up your boxer, unlock powerful new abilities, and build a fighting style that evolves as you progress. Mix traditional boxing with unique skills that can turn the momentum of a fight.

Realism
Prefer to keep things grounded? Realism Mode keeps the same leveling and stat system, but removes abilities from combat. Win through timing, movement, defense, stamina management, and clean punches—no special abilities, just you and your opponent.

CREATE YOUR BOXER

Build the fighter you want to bring into the ring. GloveUp! features a deep character customization system that lets you create a boxer that truly feels like your own.

  • Face — Customize your fighter’s face, eyes, irises, eyeliner, eyebrows, and more to create the look you want

  • Hair — Find the hairstyle that fits your fighter. Every hairstyle has its own unique look, with customizable color sections for even more variety

  • Body — Short, average, or tall? Fast, powerful, or durable? Shape your fighter’s build and attributes to match your preferred fighting style

  • Clothing — Mix and match shoes, socks, shorts, headbands, dresses, tattoos, and more to create a look that stands out in the ring

LEVEL UP - STATS - ABILITIES

Earn Stats as you level up and distribute them however you like. Whether you want to be a hard-hitting knockout artist, a lightning-fast counterpuncher, or an unstoppable endurance fighter, the choice is yours.

Unlock powerful Abilities as you progress, giving you the edge when you need it most. Whether you're looking to overwhelm your opponent, survive a brutal exchange, or stage an incredible comeback, the right abilities can turn the tide of any fight.

STEP INTO THE RING

Duck, punch, weave, counter, and clinch your way through every fight. Read your opponent, learn their habits, and discover what works against different opponents. Control the pace, pick your openings, and knock your opponent out!

UNQIUE VENUES

Immerse yourself in the fantasy world that is GloveUp! From floating fruits in the sky to a relaxing 5 star cruise ship, bring the fight whereever you go!
